inputClockAndSchedulingChecks.scope: Actual host input/router, variable-time clock, continuation queue and presentation ordering with keyboard events and Apple synthetic extended gamepads. No engine, ROM, GUI or audio is executed; tennis/game semantics require separate engine acceptance.

limits: Synthetic Apple gamepads verify host routing; no physical controller actuation is claimed.
Offscreen AV playback is separate evidence and currently still fails strict underrun/clock-gap criteria; consult Documentation/playback-investigation.json and the later final qualification report.
These source checks do not establish visible window presentation, speaker audibility, game coverage, or final packaged-artifact validity.

linkGuard.scope: Real build entry rejects test-only marker-bearing dylibs, failed nm inspection and an actual original reference core before Swift linking.
